Are you passionate about sports and looking for an exciting career in logistics? Join our dynamic team at Decathlon's ultra-modern warehouse in Tilburg! We're seeking enthusiastic individuals to help manage our international distribution center, serving stores and customers across multiple European countries.
 Your role in our team As a Logistics Employee at Decathlon, you'll be part of a dedicated team responsible for ensuring smooth operations in our state-of-the-art facility. Your main duties will include:
  - Processing orders efficiently using advanced robotic systems
 - Collaborating with team members to meet daily goals and targets
 - Maintaining high standards of accuracy and safety in all operational processes
 - Opportunity to develop into specialized roles such as 'captain' or 'trainer'
 
 What we offer At Decathlon, we value our employees and offer a range of benefits to support your growth and well-being:
  - Competitive starting salary of €2338.27 per month (38-hour week), with potential for monthly bonuses
 - 8% holiday pay and 24 vacation days
 - 20% discount on Decathlon products
 - Comprehensive training and development opportunities
 - Employee share ownership program
 - Travel expense reimbursement (100% for bike/public transport, 50% for car up to 30km)
 - Access to sports coaching and wellness platforms
 - Regular team events and outings
 
 What we're looking for The ideal candidate for this role will possess:
  - A passion for sports and an active lifestyle
 - Flexibility to work 32-38 hours per week, including one weekend day
 - Availability for various shifts (morning, afternoon/evening, night)
 - Excellent command of English
 - Valid Dutch passport/visa/work permit
 - Residence within a 30-minute radius of our Tilburg warehouse
 - Alignment with our core values: vitality, generosity, responsibility, and authenticity
 
 About Decathlon Decathlon is a global leader in sporting goods retail, committed to making sports accessible to all.

We are currently looking for an: 
Assembly Technician 
As an Assembly Technician, you will perform assembly activities for the production of roller coaster track and train components, following technical drawings and assembly instructions. 
What will you do? - 
Carry out assembly activities in coordination with the Assembly Team Coordinator. - 
Check the availability of all components and materials required for assembly and determine the sequence of assembly operations. - 
Assemble train components and drive systems for attractions, including car bodies, seats, restraints, wheels, bearings, brakes, and hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical components. - 
Install piping and related system components. - 
Adjust and align various assembled components, such as wheel spacing, brake settings, and similar parts. - 
Perform prescribed measurements and record the results in inspection and measurement reports. - 
Carry out maintenance on tools and equipment in use and ensure they remain in good working condition. Job requirements 
What do we expect from you? - 
You have vocational knowledge at MBO level, for example through an Assembly & Maintenance Level 2 qualification. - 
You have knowledge of the materials, machines, and tools used in the assembly of roller coaster trains and drive systems. - 
You are able to read and interpret technical drawings. - 
You work accurately and pay attention to detail. - 
You are familiar with applicable quality standards and safety regulations. - 
You enjoy working together with colleagues. - 
You are proactive and service-oriented. 
What do we offer? - 
An international and dynamic working environment where you collaborate with passionate and enthusiastic colleagues who take pride in creating products that bring joy...

jobs.occupation: Logistics Employee Reach Truck at DHL Bemmel (121134003)
jobs.description:
Will you be driving a reach truck at DHL in Bemmel soon?

Would you like to start in logistics and develop yourself into a reach truck driver? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for logistics employees who want to work with a reach truck.

No certificate yet? No problem: DHL will train you internally to become a reach truck driver – fully on the job and at our expense.

What will you do?

- Operating a reach truck to store and retrieve goods, including at height
- Moving pallets and goods throughout the warehouse
- Picking and scanning orders
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Ensuring a clean, safe, and organized workplace

You will work at a location that is continuously developing, where new clients are regularly being onboarded. This means you will constantly learn new processes.

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are eager to learn and want to develop into a reach truck driver
- You work accurately and with a focus on safety
- You are available for 32 to 40 hours per week in day shifts, Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00
- You speak Dutch or English

A reach truck certificate is a plus, but not required, we value motivation and commitment more, and we will provide your internal training at DHL.
